title: lazyagent protocol v1 method params and results
description: Definitions named '<method>.params' and '<method>.result': the ten methods inherited from the legacy IPC server, then the v1 additions. Fields marked 'v1' are additions the legacy server does not send.

agent_status.description: Open set: clients must tolerate values they do not know.

confidence.description: Open set: clients must tolerate values they do not know.

agent_id.description: Optional selector: may be omitted when the worktree has exactly one agent.

agent_status.description: Roll-up over agents, kept for back-compat.

git_status.description: Present once the status has been computed.

base_branch.description: Default: the configured default_branch when a worktree has it checked out, else the main worktree's branch.

extra.description: Only used by a configured custom create command.

env.description: Environment of a custom command this call runs (the client's, D5); the engine's own when omitted.

custom_command.description: True when a custom create command ran; path is then predicted.

job_id.description: v1: custom create runs as an engine job (job.output / job.finished).

custom.description: Run the configured custom remove command as an engine job instead of git worktree remove, as the TUI does.

env.description: Environment of a custom command this call runs (the client's, D5); the engine's own when omitted.

caller.description: An agent's token: the orchestrator may not remove a worktree with unpushed work (never alone).

job_id.description: v1: custom remove runs as an engine job.

spawn_agent.params.description: worktree_path is required for kind 'agent' and ignored for 'orchestrator'.

env.description: v1: environment of the calling client; the agent inherits it.

notes_mode.description: How the agent may write its session notes; default: [notes] mode. Orchestrator workers get free.

review_comment_ids.description: The review comments in the instruction (review_register's comment_ids), registered for the new agent before it starts.

caller.description: The spawning agent's token, when an agent (the orchestrator included) asks: [orchestrator] max_spawns_per_day and max_concurrent_agents then apply, and a spawn over either is a VALIDATION_ERROR naming it. No token: the user, uncapped.

cursor.description: list_events cursor taken before the spawn.

notes.description: The agent's session notes: deleted, or kept as an orphan (orphan_days) that notes_adopt can recover.
The agent's final session notes, when not empty: the handoff of a caller with no UI to offer one.

delivery.description: Open set: clients must tolerate values they do not know.

since.description: Replay the events after this seq first; omitted or null means from now.

events.description: Only these event names; omitted or null means all. A later subscribe replaces the filter.

cursor.description: seq of the newest event when the subscription started; live events are after it.

replayed.description: How many history events follow the response, before the live ones.

truncated.description: True when events after since were already evicted from the history.

unsubscribed.description: False when there was no subscription.

from_offset.description: Resume point: offset after the last byte the client has.

stream_id.description: Per connection; output and input frames carry it.

mode.description: tail: output frames resume at from_offset. snapshot: render 'snapshot' into an empty terminal of 'size', then the output frames from 'offset'.

offset.description: Offset of the first output frame that follows.

snapshot.description: mode snapshot only: ANSI that rebuilds the screen and capped scrollback as of 'offset'.

rows.description: With cols: claim and resize in one step.

owner.description: Whether the caller owns the session's size.

env.description: Environment of a shell started by this call; ignored when it already runs.

paths.description: Omitted or null means every worktree.

base.description: U5: diff from the merge-base of this branch (or commit) and HEAD to the working tree, so committed work shows too. VALIDATION_ERROR when there is no merge-base. Default: the working tree against the index, as the TUI's tab.

max_bytes.description: U5: the cap instead of the default 64 KiB, up to 4 MiB (4194304); more is a VALIDATION_ERROR.

pr.description: The diff the branch's pull request shows (GitHub's Files changed): 'diff' is merge-base(base, HEAD)..HEAD, committed work only, and 'uncommitted' is HEAD against the working tree plus untracked files. Without 'base' the base is resolved (see the result's 'base'); 'base' is used as given, VALIDATION_ERROR when it has no merge-base.

fetch.description: With 'pr' only: 'git fetch origin <base branch>' in the worktree first, and refresh its PR info (a resolved base, or an 'origin/…' one). A failed fetch is reported as 'fetch_error', not an error.

diff.description: Capped like the TUI's diff tab. With 'pr', the committed part only.

uncommitted.description: With 'pr': staged, unstaged and untracked changes (HEAD against the working tree). It shares the cap with 'diff': each gets at least half.

base.description: With 'pr': what 'diff' is against; null when no base could be used (then 'diff' is empty and 'base_error' says why).

ref.description: The ref diffed against, e.g. origin/feature-x: origin/<branch> when that exists, else the local branch; an override as given.

branch.description: The branch it was resolved from; null for an override.

source.description: pr (the open PR's base branch), default (the configured default branch, else the main worktree's), override (the 'base' param).

refresh.description: Fetch even when a cached answer exists.

fetched.description: False when no answer could be fetched (no gh); pr_info is then null.

interest.description: The union over every client, which the pollers use.

agents.description: Empty or the one orchestrator agent (agent_id "").

pr_info.description: Worktree path -> PR info (null: no PR), for the worktrees fetched so far.

git_statuses.description: Worktree path -> full git status, for the worktrees computed so far (worktrees only carries the counts).

cursor.description: subscribe {since: cursor} continues from this state without a gap.

worktree_path.description: The worktree shown; null when the orchestrator or nothing is.

agent_id.description: The agent whose terminal is the active tab (the orchestrator's is ""); null when none is.

focus.description: Open set: clients must tolerate values they do not know.

modal.description: The open modal (spawn, create, remove, help, …) while focus is modal; else null.

seq.description: seq of the ui.command event the hosted UI acts on.

worktree_path.description: The resolved target; null is the orchestrator.

ui_target.description: true targets the orchestrator instead of a worktree.

attach_ui.params.description: Make this connection a hosted UI (a TUI on a remote engine): the ui.* commands are offered while one is attached. Dropped by detach_ui or on disconnect.

publish_view.params.description: A UI announces what it shows; emitted as ui.view_changed unless equal to the last view.

published.description: False when the view equals the last one announced.

shutdown.params.description: Stop a detached engine once the reply is sent (lazyagent engine stop). An engine inside a TUI answers VALIDATION_ERROR.

stop_agents.description: false: only stop an engine that runs no agent (VALIDATION_ERROR otherwise). An agent cannot outlive its engine: its PTY closes.

agents.description: Agents (the orchestrator included) stopped with the engine.

restorable_agent.description: An agent an earlier engine ran when it ended, from the restart manifest.

id.description: Opaque; what restore_agents and dismiss_restorable take.

worktree_path.description: The orchestrator's key for kind orchestrator.

conversation_id.description: The provider's conversation id when it reported one; a restore resumes exactly it, else the provider's last conversation.

instruction.description: The last instruction sent to it, when known (first 4,096 characters).

notes_id.description: Its session notes, carried to the restored agent (proposal 0011); null when it has none.

env.description: The environment the agents start from (the calling client's, D5); default: the engine's.

notes_mode.description: manual: the agent writes only when the user asks (advisory); propose: its writes are proposals (behaves as manual until propose lands); free: it writes directly.

notes_by.description: Who wrote last; null for the untouched template.

notes_caller.description: The calling agent's token (LAZYAGENT_AGENT_TOKEN in its MCP server's env). Without worktree_path the target is the caller's own notes. Another agent's token may read but not write; the orchestrator's token writes as the orchestrator, no token as the user.

max_bytes.description: A write above it is refused (VALIDATION_ERROR: condense them).

notes_id.description: Any notes by id (an ended agent's too), instead of a target.

instruction.description: The pinned instruction (the agent's first prompt), read-only.

if_rev.description: The rev the edit started from; a stale one is a CONFLICT carrying the current {rev, text}.

section.description: A '## ' heading name, matched case-insensitively; created at the end when missing.

text.description: Each line becomes a list item ('- ') unless it already is one or is indented.
The section's new body, up to the next '## ' heading.

worktree_path.description: Only this worktree's (the orchestrator's key for its notes).

expires_at.description: When an orphan is deleted; null for the others.

notes_id.description: Ended notes (orphan or restorable) to recover.

worktree_path.description: The live agent that takes them (its text is replaced).

if_rev.description: The live notes' rev; a stale one is a CONFLICT.

notes_id.description: Ended notes; a live agent's go with it (stop_agent).

review_reply_item.description: An agent's answer to one review comment (review_reply).

agent_id.description: A live agent there: the one the comments were sent to.

comment_ids.description: The ids its prompt gives (at most 64 letters, digits, - or _); a comment sent again (a follow-up, another agent) keeps every agent it went to.

caller.description: The answering agent's token (LAZYAGENT_AGENT_TOKEN): required; the comment must have been registered for that agent.

status_row.description: One work item (proposal 0013): a branch with its worktree, agents and PR, projected by the engine; nothing in it is stored.

title.description: The PR title, else the linked tracker task's title, else the branch.

zone.description: inbox: the ball is the user's; parked: the user parked the whole work item (its inbox items wait with it, feature parked).

level.description: Inbox rows only. now: an agent is blocked on the user; deep: needs reading (To sit down with).

state.description: A fact in at most five words, e.g. 'review requested, CI green'.

rule.description: The derivation rule that matched (inbox-plan.md §3); 0: a user rule of its own (not a replaced built-in).

rule_id.description: status_list fields only (feature rules): the catalog rule's id.

verb.description: status_list fields only: the line's verb (Merge, Fix CI, ...), null when no rule gives one.

action.description: status_list fields only: the primary action's id (rules_catalog actions).

blocks_agent.description: An agent waits on the user's answer: first in its level.

needs_you.description: The work item's open inbox items (actionables_list); null when it has none.

top.description: The first item's id, in the queue's order.

since.description: When it took this status (Unix time).

spawned_by.description: orchestrator for the orchestrator's workers (its token at spawn_agent); absent when not recorded.

note.description: The first open Pending item, else the last Doubt, of an agent's session notes.

gesture.description: The user's label, park or close while it holds (feature gestures).

claim.description: The orchestrator holds the item (Pass to orchestrator, feature claims); null otherwise.

hold.description: The orchestrator's own hold (orchestrator_hold, or the engine's for its workers' finished work; feature holds): state 'orchestrator · <note>', in flight.

delegation.description: An inbox item the user delegated to the branch's agent (feature delegation).

suggestion.description: A hint for the user, never done for them, e.g. 'close PR #12: its head is in develop'.

tracker.description: The issue-tracker task linked by the branch name (optional adapters, [trackers]); absent when none is linked. Read-only: the engine never writes to a tracker.

key.description: The task key read from the branch name.

state.description: The mapped state text, else the raw status: shown beside the engine's state.

at.description: When it was last read (Unix time).

stale.description: The tracker failed since: the value is the last good one.

qa.description: The task's QA value from the [<adapter>.qa] mapping (the tracker.qa fact); absent when unknown.

stale.description: Nothing but a branch, unchanged for [status] stale_days: hidden unless include_done.

changed_at.description: When its facts last changed (Unix time): the row's age.

fingerprint.description: A hash of the facts that move it across a rule.

class.description: Inbox rows only: deep when its level is deep (needs reading), else quick.

seen_at.description: The user's last look at it (status_seen: this item's mark or 'all seen', the later); null: never.

last_event_at.description: Its latest timeline entry (status_timeline); later than seen_at: changed since the user looked.

holder.description: Who has the ball (feature first_responder; agent with orchestrator_activity): user for an inbox row, and a parked row whose items are still the user's; orchestrator while it holds the item (a pass, rule 13; its hold, rule 15; a routed brief or question, rule 14); agent while an agent has it directly (it works, idles on the item, reported the ball, or was delegated the item, rule 16); else null (others, stalled, done).

activity_at.description: The newest sign of work on the item (feature orchestrator_activity): the branch's last commit, its agents' notes edits (live or restorable), the agent's status_report, a timeline entry by someone other than the engine, an agent status change the engine saw happen (not the first sighting when it starts). A stalled row's changed_at is this (never the engine's start), and 'no activity' compares it with [status] stalled_hours. Null: nothing known.

last_step.description: The newest timeline entry that is not a ball or state change (feature orchestrator_activity).

project.description: The linked feeder work item's project (feature work_items); absent when no feeder item is linked.

depends_on.description: The linked feeder work item's dependencies (URLs); absent when none is linked.

waits_on.description: Of those, the ones still open or in review: 'waits on <title>'.

feeder.description: The feeder work item linked by the branch (its ticket key or its branch); absent when none is.

continue_while_review.description: The orchestrator may start the next task whose dependencies are merged or in review, within its mandate and the spawn caps; the engine wakes it once when one becomes startable.

state.description: review: its row has an open PR.

work_item.description: A work item from an external feeder (work_items_upsert, proposal 0013 I6), one per URL.

ticket.description: Its ticket key (given, else read from its URL with [status] ticket_pattern): links it to the branch with that key.

active.description: False once until has passed or the user unparked it (until the feeder sends a different waiting).

waiting.description: The feeder holds it in a Waiting lane: its row is parked as 'waiting (<source>)' or 'waiting: <reason>'.

startable.description: not_started_items only: its project continues while review and every dependency is merged or in review.

facts.description: The tracker facts the feeder gave; absent when none.

work_item_facts.description: Tracker facts from a feeder, for a tracker with no adapter (proposal 0014, Q-R15): the rules read them as tracker.*; an adapter's value for the same row wins. Null or "unknown": the fact stays unknown.

tracker.status.description: The task's raw status, at most 80 characters.

source.description: At most 32 letters, digits, _ . -. Who feeds it; [status] max_open_per_source (50) open items each.

until.description: A Unix time, tomorrow, or a park event; none: until the feeder clears it.

facts.description: Left out: none (an upsert replaces them).

key.description: The work item row it joined, null while no branch links to it (it counts as not started).

closed.description: False: no work item had that URL.

gesture.description: A user's gesture on a work item (proposal 0013 I4).

ball.description: label: the ball it puts on the row (rule 8); the state stays a fact.

text.description: label: at most 40 characters, e.g. 'QA'; park: the reason (optional).

until.description: park: the whole work item waits in Parked, 'parked until ...' (rule 7).

waiting.description: A feeder's Waiting lane, not the user's park (by 'feeder:<source>'): state 'waiting (<source>)' or 'waiting: <text>'.

repo.description: Only this repo's rows (the repo root's directory name).

include_done.description: Also the done (merged, closed) and stale rows.

fields.description: Feature rules, opt-in (Q-R20): add these to every row. rule_id: the catalog rule that matched (queue: the row's top inbox item decides); verb and action: that rule's, or the top item's.

caller.description: The asking agent's token, if any: counted, nothing else.

rows.description: Inbox first (level, blocks an agent, priority, oldest first), then in flight (ball: agent, others, stalled, done; priority; latest change first).

deep.description: Rows in To sit down with.

deep_max.description: [inbox] deep_max: shown against deep, never enforced.

not_started.description: Tasks no local branch links to, once per URL: the tracker adapters' assigned tasks and the feeders' work items (not those waiting).

parked_needs_you.description: Of those, the ones with inbox items still the user's (not routed to the orchestrator).

auto_actions.description: The orchestrator's own decisions and actions today (feature first_responder).

auto_reverted.description: Of those, reverted by the user today.

orchestrator.description: The orchestrator as Home shows it (feature orchestrator_activity).

report.description: Its last status_report: what it says it is doing now.

queue.description: The passes and holds in force, soonest until first.

note.description: A hold's note; empty for a pass.

by.description: user (a pass), orchestrator or engine (a hold).

auto.description: The engine's hold on its worker's done or review item.

not_started_items.description: What counts.not_started counts, highest priority first (present when a feeder has work items): feeder items as work_item plus startable, tracker tasks as {url, title, source: tracker:<adapter>, priority, ticket}.

actionable.description: An inbox item (proposal 0013): it lives while its condition holds and resolves itself when it clears.

id.description: Stable while the condition holds, e.g. Approval:<worktree>/<agent_id>, Ci:<worktree>:<pr number>, tracker:<adapter>:<key>:<status>.

occurrence.description: <id>@<since>: what a dismissal hides; the same condition later is a new occurrence.

kind.description: Open set. ci_failed: a fresh red Actions run on the head of a branch with no PR (feature actions).

level.description: Fixed per kind (tracker_status: the tracker mapping's; decision: the brief's). now: an agent is blocked on the user; deep: needs reading (To sit down with).

class.description: deep exactly when the level is deep: fixed per kind, or the brief's.

run.description: ci / ci_failed: the fresh red Actions run on the head (feature actions); null otherwise.

rule_id.description: kind rule only (feature rules): the item rule that makes it, e.g. merge. Its id is Rule:<rule id>:<work item>.

verb.description: kind rule only: the rule's verb.

label.description: The agent's label, '#<n> <PR title>', the job's title, or the tracker task's title.

state.description: Its work item row's state while it is the row's top item (at most five words).

work_item.description: The status row's key; null for the orchestrator and jobs.

blocks_agent.description: An agent waits on the answer: first in its level.

priority.description: Its work item's; medium until a feeder sets one.

since.description: When the condition was first seen (Unix time).

ci_run.description: A GitHub Actions run that failed on a branch's head (feature actions).

attempt.description: The run attempt (a re-run keeps the id).

failed_jobs.description: null until fetched (once per run attempt).

step.description: The first failing step; empty when unknown.

actionable_until.description: A Unix time, tomorrow (08:00 local, kept as that time), or an event: ci_done (CI ran and finished), agent_stopped (an agent ran and none runs now, or one there at park time is gone), human_review (the PR's review decision changed), change (CI, the review, the head commit or an agent's status moved), indefinite (until unparked).

repo.description: Only items of this repo's work items (the repo root's directory name).

include_hidden.description: Also the parked items (with park set).

items.description: Level (now, round, deep), then blocks an agent, priority, oldest first.

deep.description: Items in To sit down with.

deep_max.description: [inbox] deep_max: shown against deep, never enforced.

action.description: dismiss hides this occurrence for every client; park hides the item until 'until'; unpark shows it again; undismiss brings back the dismissed current occurrence, and for 10 minutes what the dismissal forgot (an exit, a failed job, a delegation, a claim handed back; feature undo).

caller.description: The orchestrator's token, or none (the user); a worker's token is refused.

claim.description: A work item passed to the orchestrator until a time (proposal 0013 §5c, feature claims).

until.description: Unix time; past it the claim lapses and the item returns to the user's Round.

allowed.description: The actions the claim allows (the away mandate's).

hold.description: The orchestrator's own hold on a work item (feature holds).

until.description: Past it the item goes to the user: 'orchestrator did not respond'.

by.description: orchestrator (orchestrator_hold) or engine (its workers' finished work).

note.description: What it is doing, at most 60 characters.

auto.description: The engine's hold on its worker's done or review item.

delegation.description: An inbox item handed to the branch's agent (status_gesture delegate to: agent).

phase.description: on_it: the agent has it (the item is out of the inbox); returned: the agent finished and the fact still holds.

sent_at.description: When the line reached the agent.

state.description: returned: 'agent a1 finished; still CI red …'.

note.description: What the orchestrator is doing (verifying, waiting on a merge): shown on the row.

caller.description: The orchestrator's token (required).

kind.description: label: a ball and a short text until the facts cross a rule; park: until a time or an event; close: done or dropped; delegate: pass the item to the orchestrator (a claim); keep_for_me: the orchestrator's mandate there is none (nothing is routed to it); clear: drop the gesture, the keep and take back a pass; undo: reverse only 'what' (feature undo).

what.description: undo only (required): park (the user's park goes, the gesture it replaced comes back), delegate (the delegation to the agent ends, its pending line is dropped), pass (the claim ends; a hold stays).

stop_agents.description: close only (feature close_stop): also stop every agent of the item's worktree, their notes kept; the worktree, branch and PR are left alone.

text.description: label: at most 40 characters; park: the reason (optional); delegate to agent: the line the agent gets (default: the item's fact).

to.description: delegate only: the orchestrator (a claim), or the branch's agent (one inbox item, feature delegation).

item.description: delegate to agent: the inbox item's id (default: the row's top item).

agent_id.description: delegate to agent: a live agent on the branch (default: the first).

ttl_s.description: delegate only: how long the claim lasts, at most 86400; default [orchestrator] claim_ttl_s (7200).

caller.description: None: gestures are the user's.

delegation.description: delegate to agent: the delegation made.

stopped.description: close only: the agents stopped (stop_agents), empty otherwise.

delegation_sent.description: undo delegate: the line had already reached the agent (it may act on it).

outcome.description: done: nothing for the user; returned: back to the user's Round with the note.

note.description: At most 200 characters, shown on the returned item.

caller.description: The orchestrator's token (required).

outcome.description: nothing_to_release: no pass or hold on the item any more (released, lapsed, its worktree removed); not an error.

claim.description: The pass that ended; null when it was a hold, or nothing was released.

timeline_entry.description: A fact on a work item's timeline (since you looked, proposal 0013 I4): no generated text.

at.description: When it happened (a commit: its commit time).

actor.description: user, agent:<id>, orchestrator or engine (what the engine saw).

ref.description: A commit sha, a decision id, a notes id, or an outward action's ref.

mandate.description: The orchestrator's: present, away or claim.

action.description: The orchestrator's (or a revert's): answer_quick, answer_reversible, answer_partly, spawn_worker, escalate, revert, ...

inverse.description: What Revert runs: a list of, or one, {kind: git_reset | stop_agent, ...}.

note.description: One line (at most 200 characters): the row's note, with its age.

ball.description: Who has the ball now, when the engine cannot see it (e.g. others: QA).

needs_user.description: The user must act: a Round item until the agent runs again after its turn, or is sent input.

outward.description: Best effort: something done outside the repo, added to the item's timeline as done by the agent.

until.description: When the ball lapses: a Unix time, or a duration from now such as "45m", "2h", "1h30m" (at most 8 h; default 2 h for ball agent, none for others / stalled, which hold until the agent's next turn). While the ball holds, the agent's ended turn is not "agent finished" (it works on in the background); past until, or once the agent runs again and ends a turn with no new report, the engine's derivation is back.

caller.description: The agent's token (required): the report is on its own work item. The orchestrator's token: only a note, what it is doing now (status_list orchestrator.report, feature orchestrator_activity).

key.description: The worker's work item; null for the orchestrator's report.

report.description: A worker's report, or the orchestrator's {note, at}.

turn_over.description: The agent has ended a turn since.

until.description: When the ball lapses (the report's until; ball agent: 2 h after it by default; null: at the agent's next turn only).

key.description: One work item; none: mark all seen.

at.description: Unix time, default now (never later than now).

seen.description: '*' (all seen) and per work item key: Unix times.

since.description: Default: the client's last look at the item; none either: every entry kept.

entries.description: Oldest first; at most 50 per item, none older than 7 days.

path.description: diff, file: inside the worktree (kept relative to it).

sha.description: diff, file: the commit it is pinned to; default the branch head at request time.

section.description: notes: a section of the agent's notes.

decision.description: A decision brief (proposal 0013 §5b): an agent's question that needs reading.

holder.description: Who is to answer it: orchestrator while it holds it as first responder (no inbox item), else user.

source.description: question: an agent's plain question routed to the orchestrator; auto_delegate: written by the engine. Absent for a brief.

routed.description: When it went to the orchestrator first.

capped.description: Why it went to the user: the orchestrator's caps for the day.

revertible.description: An orchestrator answer the user may still revert (decision_revert).

inverse.description: What Revert runs: {kind: git_reset, sha, branch} / {kind: stop_agent, worktree_path, agent_id}.

explain.description: The last Explain this on it (feature decision_view).

rebrief.description: The last Request a new brief on it (feature decision_view).

valid.description: false: fewer than 2 options, an unknown recommendation or no evidence; shown as a quick 'agent <id> asks: ...'.

blocking.description: The agent waits for the answer: first in its level (quick: Now).

tried.description: At most 600 characters; may hold line breaks.

invalid.description: Why it is not valid (empty when it is).

sha.description: The branch head when it was asked.

choice.description: An option's key, or the answer itself when there are no options.

presence.description: The orchestrator's mandate when it answered: present, away or claim.

delivered_at.description: When the line reached the agent.

replaces.description: One of the agent's open briefs: superseded by this one.

caller.description: The agent's token (required).

message.description: What the agent is told: where the brief is, or why it is not a full one.

caller.description: The asking agent's token (required).

presence.description: Whether the user is around (feature first_responder): mode is the override (auto follows input reports); no UI connected is away.

choice.description: An option's key; with no options (a plain question), the answer.

comment.description: At most 500 characters, sent with the choice.

reason.description: The orchestrator's (required with its token): shown to the user, at most 300 characters.

caller.description: The orchestrator's token, or none (the user).

suggestion.description: An option's key, preselected for the user.

caller.description: The orchestrator's token (required).

choice.description: The user's choice instead (an option's key).

caller.description: None: the user's.

input_at.description: The user's last input the client saw (Unix seconds).

repo.description: The repo's name or root (the engine's own).

auto_delegate.description: ci_red is accepted but inactive until CI runs are read (I7).

caller.description: None: the user's.

decision_explain.description: An Explain this or Request a new brief request and its answer (feature decision_view, proposal 0013 I5).

target.description: The decision id, or key:<work item key>.

id.description: The brief; null for an explanation of a work item.

route.description: Who was asked: the owner agent, the owner after an explicit restore, or the orchestrator.

agent.description: The owner agent's id, when known.

question.description: The user's own question (Explain), at most 300 characters.

note.description: The user's note (rebrief), at most 300 characters.

sent_at.description: When the prompt reached the agent (its turn was over).

truncated.description: The reply was cut to 10 lines.

key.description: Or a work item (any inbox item) to explain.

question.description: The user's own question, passed on.

restore.description: Restore the owner agent first when it is not running but restorable (Restore agent and explain); never automatic.

caller.description: None: the user's only.

id.description: An open brief of the user's.

note.description: What the new brief should cover.

caller.description: None: the user's only.

id.description: The brief the user asked about.

text.description: At most 10 lines; the rest is cut.

caller.description: The owner agent's token or the orchestrator's.

message.description: Set when the reply was cut.

start.description: The first line's number in text.

total.description: Lines in the whole file, log or section.

error.description: Why it cannot be read here.

key.description: A work item: its fresh red runs on the head.

run_id.description: One run of the repo's latest runs instead.

jobs.description: Per failed job: its failing step and the last lines of its failed log (at most 3 jobs, 30 lines each).

total.description: Lines in the job's failed log; 0 when it could not be read.

text.description: The summary as an agent gets it on a delegation (at most 6000 characters).

error.description: What could not be read (the log, the jobs); the rest is still there.

approval_answer.params.description: Feature approval_answer. One of id and key.

key.description: A work item: its first open approval item.

allow.description: true allows the tool call, false denies it.

caller.description: None: approvals are the user's; any token is refused.

key.description: Its work item; null for the orchestrator's own prompt.

sent.description: The key written to the prompt: allow is 1 (Claude Code) or y (Codex), deny is Esc.

question_answer.params.description: Feature question_answer. One of id and key.

id.description: The question item's id (Question:<worktree>/<agent>), or a routed question's decision item.

key.description: A work item: its first open question (an item, else a question record routed to the orchestrator).

text.description: The answer, one paragraph, at most 2000 characters (200 when it answers a question record).

caller.description: None: answers are the user's; any token is refused.

queued.description: Always true: the answer reaches the agent once its turn is over (at its question it is).

decision.description: The question record answered (decision_answer's path); null when the text went to the agent directly.

since.description: Unix time; default local midnight today.

caller.description: None (the user) or the orchestrator's token; a worker's is refused.

actions.description: The orchestrator's timeline entries of kinds action, decision and delegate, newest first.

decision_id.description: The decision the entry is about (its ref), if any.

revertible.description: That decision is the orchestrator's answer and the user can still revert it (decision_revert).

view.description: null until a UI has announced one.

worktree_path.description: Default: the worktree the UI shows.

agent_id.description: Omitted: the active agent tab, or the last one.

worktree_path.description: Default: the worktree the UI shows.
Default: the worktree the UI shows.

ui.blank.params.description: The hosted UI shows no worktree (a placeholder) until the next ui command, so it renders no agent: a host that shows the agents natively sends it while the hosted UI is out of sight.

worktree_path.description: Default: the worktree the UI shows. create ignores it and answers worktree_path null.

since.description: Cursor; omitted or null means from now.

statuses.description: Status values or group names (idle, blocked, finished, not_running).

rules_problem.description: A rule file error or warning.

line.description: 1-based; null when the file as a whole is at fault.

rule.description: The rule id, when one rule is at fault.

fallback.description: What is in force instead, e.g. 'skipped; the built-in is in force', 'the last good version is in force'.

pending.description: repo file not allowed at this content hash: the hash to allow.

allowed.description: repo only: the user allowed this hash.

rules.description: Rule tables in the applied version.

num.description: The row's rule integer; 0 for a user rule of its own.

item.description: An inbox item rule (with the queue on, the row reaches the inbox through queue).

then.description: ball, level, state, blocks_agent, suggestion (or <field>_expr), inherit.

sentence.description: rules_catalog only (R6): the condition in English, from the facts' phrases.

zone.description: rules_catalog only (R6): where the rule leads (inbox: the queue, its top item's level).

state_text.description: rules_catalog only (R6): the state, a template with ‹holes› for an expression.

queue_off.description: rules_catalog only (R6): a rule for an engine with the inbox queue off.

repo.description: The engine's repo (name or root); others are refused.

rules.description: The effective row rules, first match wins.

concepts.description: The "How lazyagent works" page's hand-written part (concepts.toml, R6): sections {id, title, intro, generated, screenshot, caption, cards}, zones, balls, the example line, colours, keys {keys, where, does}.

review.description: R3b: the rule files' [review] tables, merged; not_human: the logins pr.human_approvals leaves out (lower case).

key.description: A status_list row key, or a branch name.

inherited_from.description: park, label: the rule below that gave the inherited field.

item_rule.description: queue matched on a rule's item (Merge): that rule (rules_rule), the facts it read, and above: the rules between the locked prefix and it, as above.

failed.description: The first top-level condition that was not true.

said.description: R6: that condition in English (absent with value item or true).

file.description: A user rule's file (with line and facts, what it read).

items.description: The row's open inbox items, top first.

rules_allow.params.description: Feature rules. The user's only (no caller token).

hash.description: The repo file's content hash (rules_check files), or its first 12+ characters.

rules_allow.result.description: rules_check's result, and what was allowed.

truncated.description: True when events after since were already evicted.

restores.description: Present only when agents were restored after since: each engine.restored, with its seq. Engine-wide: the filters do not apply.
